_comment: Cards that exist only for the enters-untapped trigger-filter test (tests/unit/replacement/test_enters_untapped.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_untapped_conqueror` is Charismatic Conqueror's trigger shape, cut down to a bare life-gain payload so the test measures the FILTER and not a token pool or a may-decision. `t_loose_conqueror` writes the identical card with the `tapped` clause removed -- the card the engine used to produce silently, since the key loaded and was dropped. `t_tapped_conqueror` asks the opposite question, to pin that the key is read as a value rather than as a mere presence check.

cards.name: Test Untapped Conqueror
cards.oracle_text: Whenever an artifact or creature an opponent controls enters untapped, you gain 1 life.
